questions.question: At which ground did Mieke de Ridder record their career-best innings (55, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Buffalo Park, against Iinyathi on 2022/03/13.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2016 season?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk won it in 2016.

questions.question: At Victory Park, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
Who has achieved the 100+ runs and 3+ wickets in a match double more times, Lanette Pienaar or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Lanette Pienaar: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.

questions.question: At which ground did Eastern Storm record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Uplands College — largest win by runs of 218, against Rhinos on 2025/03/01.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most 50+ Scores' in the 05/06 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Johmari Logtenberg holds it, with a total of 5.
